description: The doors as in the paper: scene, reset poses, scale, alpha, ss, horizon and 50 rollouts from paper_experiments/calvin_articulated_object.sh and calvin_exp_configs_examples/door_*.json, everything but the door random. Two sets of the same 20 robot poses: original (the recorded image and scene, as in the paper) and recombined (rendered without blocks in all 8 scenes, 160 conditions), and the base policy from the same start scenes. A rollout ends at the full slide (or 400 steps); dynaguide_scripts/score_paper_rule.py also scores it with the authors' rule. Run on the workstation with dynaguide_scripts/run_doors_paper.bat
